title: Kya aapka paisa savings account mein so raha hai?
body: Savings account mein rakha paisa inflation ki wajah se dheere-dheere apni purchasing power khota hai. Smart planning aur financial education ki madad se aap apne paise ko sahi tarike se manage karna seekh sakte hain. Fund Kuber AI ke sath apni investment learning journey ko aaj hi shuru karein.
